value.body: Sales executives find customers and sell a company's products or services to meet targets. They work in FMCG, consumer durables, financial services, real estate, software and many other sectors, and the day mixes calls, client visits, demos, follow-ups and reporting on the pipeline.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: Graduates from any stream; BBA / B.Com common

items.label: Common tools
items.value: CRM software, Excel, phone and email

items.label: Common titles
items.value: Sales officer, business development executive, field sales executive

items.label: Indian retail market size
items.note: Estimate; retail is one of many sectors that hire sales staff

items.label: B.Com. enrolment
items.note: A common entry degree; most graduates go into other roles too
items.source: AISHE 2023-24, Table 11 (programme-wise enrolment, all modes, actual responses)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Most freshers enter through campus drives or walk-in hiring by sales-heavy sectors, which value communication over a specific degree. A two-wheeler and willingness to travel are often expected for field roles.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Explaining a product and handling objections
Planning a territory or account list

value.title: At a glance
items: Pay usually includes a variable, target-linked part.
Common next steps: area sales manager, key account manager, or business development lead.
Attrition is high in entry-level sales; targets can be demanding.
